summary:
We have developed an interactive educational yet fun children learning app for kids between the age of 7 to 12. It allows young learners to discover about solar planets and different exoplanets. After exploring, kids can take fun quizzes to test their knowledge and earn planets based rewards.
By combining space education and gamification, Our app transforms learning into an exciting and rewarding experience.Its goal is to spark children's curiosity about astronomy and encourage independent learning.
details: Our app gives information about any solar or exoplanet that you click on. Like the planet's age, Its composition and how big it is as compared to earth etc. After learning, the next step is taking a fun quiz that is made from the material you just learned. You will answer 7-10 multiple choice based questions. In the end, you will get a score based on the options you marked right. And it will tell you the correct option for the ones you marked wrong. The intended impact of our project is to make space education more accessible,engaging and enjoyable for kids. By using our app, kids can develop an interest for space education from an early age and learn fun facts about different space bodies. We used Typescript and CSS for the designing of our app. Our project is creative as it combines learning with gamification and encourage active participation in learning by giving kids an aim to score highest in the quiz.
